title: Update comments in `wiretap/file_access.c`
description:
Update the comment on `wtap_register_open_info()` to direct the reader
to use `WTAP_OPEN_FOO` instead of 1/0/-1 as return values from the
`open_file_*` routines.

Harmonize block comment style to the style used first in the file.
Correct some tpyos. Add comments to (some) functions lacking them.

commits_data.title: Update comments in `wiretap/file_access.c`
commits_data.message:
Update comments in `wiretap/file_access.c`

Update the comment on `wtap_register_open_info()` to direct the reader
to use `WTAP_OPEN_FOO` instead of 1/0/-1 as return values from the
`open_file_*` routines.

Harmonize block comment style to the style used first in the file.
Correct some tpyos. Add comments to (some) functions lacking them.
